name: Microgrid staged load-restoration scheduler
aliases: microgrids Microgrid load shedding and restoration
summary: Sequences the assigned load-group reconnection requests under the documented restoration strategy.
description: Sequences the assigned load-group reconnection requests under the documented restoration strategy. Load management balances the available electrical supply against the loads that remain connected. Shedding, restoration, priority and proof of disconnection are separate control functions and should remain traceable to individual load groups.

In a microgrid island, the controller can disconnect lower-priority loads when a source is lost and later request restoration when the documented reserve and stability conditions permit it. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Eligible load groups” at the input and “Staged restoration requests” at the output. A delay alone does not establish successful load acceptance.

Identify each load group, priority, measured contribution and feedback. Shedding amounts, operating times and restoration conditions require the approved power-management design and the actual connected-load data. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
